roles.definition: Original bytes treated as the subject of a validation, claim, or transformation.
Bytes produced from one or more predecessor objects by an explicit transformation.
Container or encoding used to transport objects; never substitutes for contained source objects.
Structured description of objects, bindings, roles, relationships, or publication state.
Evidence that a defined event, binding, or platform action occurred within an assurance scope.
Authenticated or otherwise bound statement about one or more subjects under a typed predicate.
Machine-readable structural or semantic contract for instances.
Result of applying a named validator/test profile to named subject bytes/state.
Discovery or chain entry that points to another object and records bounded metadata.
Current pointer/checkpoint to a ledger state; mutable by append-only progression, not by historical rewrite.
Proposed change bytes not yet integrated into the stable implementation.
External publication/transparency/archive evidence about an object or statement.

open_question: Whether one immutable object may carry multiple simultaneous role assertions should be represented through separate role bindings rather than a single role field on the object itself.
